description: This file defines Zod schemas and validation functions for channel configuration objects, including handling legacy bindings and runtime schema retrieval, within a messaging or communication platform.

methods.name: getDirectChannelRuntimeSchemas
methods.description: Retrieves and caches runtime schemas for channels based on bundled plugin metadata.

methods.name: hasPluginOwnedChannelConfig
methods.description: Checks if a ChannelsConfig object contains plugin-owned channel configurations.

methods.name: addLegacyChannelAcpBindingIssues
methods.description: Recursively adds issues to the validation context for legacy ACP binding structures.

methods.name: normalizeBundledChannelConfigs
methods.description: Normalizes channel configurations by validating and updating them with runtime schemas.
